primary_meaning: The wicked (children of the evil one/devil) who are sown among the righteous (true believers) and left to grow together until the final judgment/harvest, when they will be separated and destroyed

alternatives.meaning: False or hypocritical Christians (or heretics) appearing similar to true believers within the visible church
Sin, evil influences, or worldly elements mixed into the life of the believer or the church

notes: The primary meaning is fixed by Jesus' own explicit interpretation of the parable; later Christian teaching almost uniformly follows that explanation while applying it to false professors in the church or the world.
